name: rootiest-ai
description: Reusable AI skills for Claude Code and Antigravity CLI

plugins.name: caveman
plugins.description: Ultra-compressed communication mode from JuliusBrussee/caveman — cuts output tokens while keeping full technical accuracy. Installed straight from the upstream repo, not vendored here.

plugins.name: core-essentials
plugins.description: Core cross-tool utilities, including delegation to the Antigravity CLI (agy) for grounded research and large multi-file audits.

plugins.name: date-time
plugins.description: Retrieves the exact current date and time for time-sensitive queries, scheduling, duration calculations, and validating chronological context.

plugins.name: gitea-mcp
plugins.description: Connects Claude Code/agy to a Gitea instance via the official gitea-mcp server, authenticated with GITEA_HOST/GITEA_ACCESS_TOKEN you set locally.

plugins.name: github-mcp
plugins.description: Connects Claude Code/agy to GitHub via the official MCP server, authenticated with a GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN you set locally.

plugins.name: mattpocock-skills
plugins.description: Matt Pocock's agent skills for real engineering from mattpocock/skills — grilling, spec/ticket flows, TDD, code review, domain modelling and more. Installed straight from the upstream repo, not vendored here.

plugins.name: mirror-it
plugins.description: Configures a Gitea repository to automatically push-mirror its contents to GitHub using the tea CLI and jq.

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Lazy senior dev mode from DietrichGebert/ponytail — forces the simplest, shortest solution that actually works (YAGNI, stdlib first, no unrequested abstractions). Installed straight from the upstream repo, not vendored here.

plugins.name: ship-it
plugins.description: Ships work end to end: docs sync and code audit, PR, CI, merge, post-merge sync and branch cleanup. Each step is also its own skill (doc-it, push-it, verify-it, merge-it, sync-it, prune-it).

plugins.name: systematic-enumeration
plugins.description: Forces element-by-element verification for finite sets to prevent counting errors.

plugins.name: technical-devlog-scribe
plugins.description: Generates a highly structured, objective technical summary of a development session.

plugins.name: rootiest-ai-all
plugins.description: Reusable AI skills for Claude Code and Antigravity CLI (all skills)
